rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 3 "Phase 2: Invoke the skill on this codebase": line 39: "The skill is auto-discovered in this worktree, which holds the full codebase. Invoke it on the code as it stands." — "it" resolves to "the skill", named in the chunk's own header and repeated through the body; every other pronoun/demonstrative in the file (chunk 4 "the grade" ties to chunk 3's "the grade it gave itself"; chunk 7 "its"/"it lives at user scope" tie to "the side-quest worktree"/"the skill" in the same sentence) resolves within-chunk or against the immediately preceding chunk's named referent under sequential read.

No chunk points at another file by position. "the side quest window (m3-quality)" (chunk 0, line 5) and "~/.claude/skills/test-strategy/SKILL.md" (chunk 1, line 22) name real, fixed locations, not another file's content by its position in that file.

rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 5 "Phase 3: Ship the skill personal-first": line 58: "The skill is already shipped. The agent wrote it and your push-back sharpened it. There is no separate install step." — the chunk with the fewest bullets in the file still states a self-carrying claim (nothing left to do), not a wait-state; every other chunk carries 2+ bullets or a Note paragraph with its own claim.

chunk 6 header "Decide if it graduates to the team" (line 60) is answered by its own body (talk to the team, PR it, or stay personal) with no contradiction; same holds for the other 6 `##` headers against their bodies.

Checked all six sub-items per chunk: no "Not X. Not Y. Z." construction; no anaphora/epistrophe triple; no self-grading superlative (grep for "one of the most"/"most useful" → 0 hits); no number-plus-retraction hedge; no abstraction-noun-stack swap-candidate beyond the named, concrete phrase "same-window self-charity" (chunk 4, line 49), which names a specific mechanism (grading in the authoring context window) rather than a vague abstraction; no verb triplet with an empty leg.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All 7 `##` headings are imperative or phase-label, matching the exercise-class grammar: "Phase 1: Author the skill through conversation", "Answer from how your codebase really tests", "Phase 2: Invoke the skill on this codebase", "Sharpen the skill from what came back", "Phase 3: Ship the skill personal-first", "Decide if it graduates to the team", "Handle what's left in the worktree" — none are declarative law-claims, none needed to be.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 6 "Decide if it graduates to the team": line 64: "Agents don't unilaterally change shared team infrastructure. You do." is the closest candidate to a doctrine-restatement/aphorism kicker — it stays inside because it names the authority boundary (who may promote the skill to team scope) explicitly for the first time in the file; the two preceding bullets describe the conversation PROCESS (ask teammates, PR on a yes) but never state WHO holds the decision, so this bullet adds that priority rather than re-announcing it.
